text:
INVESTIGATIONS OF CARDIAC DISEASE IN PREGNANCY
Investigations
- Echocardiography (Doppler)
- Electrocardiography
- Plethymography
- CT scan,
- Cardiac catherization
- Pulmonary artery catherization
- Serial blood cultures (if infective endocarditis is suspected)
